# Synthetic conversion test inputs

These are neutral generated diagnostic recordings, not character reference assets or library voices. Original test text and synthetic generation; no original video/dialogue or recognizable character recording is included. They come from the actual network-denied native F5 run42449016261 at eb5ca516da3c6c8da743559c24206b4bb3ab117e. Each passed independent unprompted recognition with zero word errors and audio checks. Exact provenance, hashes and text are in conversion-inputs.json.

They replace unreliable headless macOS speech-tool output that produced 129-frame WAVs. Tests retain the existing minimum/maximum duration and neural conversion/audio/word gates. Files are copied only into the diagnostic test bundle; the IPA inspector forbids audio fixtures in the distributed app.

Provided for noncommercial development testing. The F5 model/runtime notices are maintained separately in tools/listening_licenses. These diagnostic recordings do not establish character likeness or physical-device verification.
